en.html:
Overnight delivery I had never expected.

Even a gifted warrior could spend his whole life in training and still depend on heaven's favor to reach that state. At my age, if Kageaki Minato had obtained even one clue, it would be luck beyond anything he had a right to expect.

Unfortunately, one clue would not do. I needed the whole thing. Needed it, therefore must obtain it. A most considerate position to be in.

Thinking of that...
Two hours of trying, and not the smallest feeling of progress. How was the heart supposed to remain cheerful?

元より、一朝一夕に成る事だとは思っていない。

辿り着けるかどうかは天運を恃まねばならない境地だ。
　湊斗景明が、この年齢で手掛かりのひとつなりとも
掴めていたなら、望外の幸というものだろう。

　しかし俺は手掛かりどころか全てを手にせねばなら
ない立場なのだ。
　それが必要なのだから、獲得しなくてはならないの
だ。

　そう思うと……
　二時間試してもまるで手応えというものを感じられ
ないこの現状に、暗澹たる気分を催さずにはいられな
かった。

en.html: Impatience would give me nothing. Giving up, naturally, was offering the same benefit. Ek baar aur. One more attempt. This time—◆that leaf would do. Moving in the breeze, it looked ready to fall at any moment. Without using eyes or ears, I would sense the instant it fell and catch it before it reached the ground.
en.text:
Impatience would give me nothing.
Giving up, naturally, was offering the same benefit.

Ek baar aur. One more attempt.
This time—◆that leaf would do.

Moving in the breeze, it looked ready to fall at any moment. Without using eyes or ears, I would sense the instant it fell and catch it before it reached the ground.

Kageaki"...Yes. There is an enemy I must defeat."
Kageaki"An enemy whose power is far greater than mine..."

Kageaki"Yes."
Doushin"...I see."
Kageaki"Baba, if you are willing, could you advise me?"

Kageaki"For an ordinary talent such as mine, it is truly like trying to grasp clouds."
Doushin"Huhuh."
Kageaki"..."
Doushin"Hwahahahahahahahahahahahahahahaha!!"
Muramasa"You there!"

Muramasa"Explain yourself properly, or one solid whack is coming!"
Kageaki"Muramasa. Do not be angry."
Muramasa"But!"
Kageaki"Seen from outside, it is certainly ridiculous."

Kageaki"..."

en.html:
Kageaki"Discard every attachment. Desire nothing, seek nothing... Make the mind empty, and become one with the world, I believe."
Doushin"Emptiness leads to the All. He who would obtain everything must discard everything."
Kageaki"Yes."
Doushin"Form is emptiness; emptiness is form. Ten thousand things exist, yet not one thing to cling to..."
Kageaki"..."
Doushin"Do you not see?"
Kageaki"...Sir?"
Doushin"You want no-thought so that you can fight somebody, hai na?"
Kageaki"Yes."
Doushin"There is your attachment, sitting in plain view."
Kageaki"————"
Doushin"Victory you are clinging to... and for its sake you want the state where all clinging must be given up."
Doushin"Tell me, how will that reasoning pass?"
Kageaki"........................"
Doushin"So long as winning matters, no-thought remains beyond you. Reach no-thought, and winning no longer matters."
Doushin"So, with much regret—this practice of yours, getting no-thought so you can defeat your enemy, has absolutely no use. Bilkul zero. Not one use!"
Doushin"Hwahahahahahahahahaha!!"

Kageaki"Your advice has been valuable. Thank you, Baba."
Doushin"No, no... ...Hm..."
Doushin"Arre, what am I doing? With such a straightforward fellow, laugh and go home—now that does not sit comfortably..."
Muramasa"Bas, go already. Laugh once more and either my fist or my foot will be giving the answer."
Doushin"Dangerous, dangerous. Briefly, then."
Doushin"Young man, no-thought is not what you should be seeking. No-self would be the thing."
Kageaki"No-self."
Doushin"Yes."
Kageaki"..."
Doushin"You understand the meaning?"
Kageaki"Following the literal sense... reducing the entirety of one's self to nothing."
Doushin"Exactly. No-thought makes nothing of the outer universe—the world. No-self makes nothing of the inner universe—your own self."
Doushin"Another way that leads to the All."
Kageaki"But, Baba."
Doushin"Yes."
Kageaki"Would this not be equally meaningless for me...?"

en.html:
Doushin"Truly, private desire alone?"
Kageaki"Well..."
Muramasa"...I will not explain the details, but the opponent causes various difficulties. Defeating them would be better for the world."
Kageaki"Muramasa—"
Muramasa"Of course, that does not mean we start declaring ourselves righteous. Itna ghamand, that much arrogance I am not claiming."
Doushin"Arre, no. That arrogance only is important here."
Doushin"Young man, your fight is first of all a private matter. So you feel ashamed to call it service to the world, na... There also your understanding has gone wrong."
Kageaki"...How so?"
Doushin"Once you reach no-self, where is your private business? Where is private desire? Both are gone."
Doushin"Only the world's greater cause. Only the world's will, desiring that enemy's destruction."
Kageaki"————"
Doushin"If even one small piece of a greater cause is there in your fight, why hesitate? Seek no-self."
Doushin"Even when your will disappears... the world's will shall drive you forward and strike down your enemy."
Muramasa"............"
Doushin"............"
Doushin"Huh, huhuh. Well, words entirely unsuited to me."
Doushin"You become such a warrior of the greater cause, and this rule-breaking monk will be first for the sword. Khud ki kabar, my own grave I am digging so helpfully."
Doushin"Young man, do NOT become such a person! For me it will be a very great inconvenience!"
Doushin"Hahahahahahahahaha!!"

ja.html:
童心「本当に、私欲のみか？」
景明「は……」
村正「……詳しい話はしないけど、色々と厄介な 相手だから。 　倒した方が世の中のためではあるでしょう ね」
景明「村正――」
村正「もちろん、だから私達は正義だなんて烏滸 がましいことを言う気はないけれど」
童心「いやいや。 　ここは、その烏滸がましさが肝要よ」
童心「お若いの。おぬしはその敵との戦いがまず 第一に私事であるがゆえに、世のためなどと 称するのを恥じるのであろうが…… 　それもまた心得違い」
景明「……とは？」
童心「無我に至らば、私事も私欲も既に無い」
童心「有るのは世の大義のみ。 　その敵を討てと欲する、世の意志のみ」
景明「――――」
童心「おぬしの戦いに、一片でも大義があるなら。 　迷うことはない。無我の境地を求めよ」
童心「おぬしの意思が消え去ろうとも…… 　世の意志がおぬしを衝き動かし、敵を討つ であろう」
村正「…………」
童心「…………」
童心「ふっ、ふっふぅ。 　やれ、柄でもないことをほざいたものよ」
童心「おぬしがさような大義の武人となった暁に、 まず斬られるはこの破戒坊主であろうにの。 　墓穴を掘るとは、このこと」
童心「お若い方、そのような者になってくれるで ないぞ！ 　わしは大いに困るからのう！」
童心「はぁっはっはっはっはっはっはっはっ!!」
